scripts.build:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development docker compose -f environments/dev/compose.dev.yaml --env-file environments/dev/.env.dev up -d --build
scripts.build:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production docker compose -f environments/prod/compose.prod.yaml --env-file environments/prod/.env.prod up -d --build
scripts.destroy:dev: docker compose -f environments/dev/compose.dev.yaml down -v && docker system prune -af --volumes
scripts.destroy:prod: docker compose -f environments/prod/compose.prod.yaml down -v && docker system prune -af --volumes
